import zlib
src=open('/app/recover.py').read().split('for fn in sorted')[0]
ns={}
exec(src,ns)
fwd=ns['fwd']; rev=ns['rev']
data=open('/app/corrupted/img_01_alley.png','rb').read()
seg=data[256:291]
ctype=b'tEXt'
pos=[i for i,b in enumerate(seg) if b==0x0a]
print('0a positions',pos)
segs=[]; last=0
for p in pos:
    segs.append(bytes(seg[last:p])); last=p
segs.append(bytes(seg[last:]))
print('segs',segs)
n=len(pos); half=n//2
start=fwd(0xffffffff,ctype); start=fwd(start,segs[0])
fwdmap={}
for bits in range(1<<half):
    s=start
    for j in range(half):
        if bits>>j&1: s=fwd(s,b'\x0d')
        s=fwd(s,b'\x0a')
        if j!=half-1: s=fwd(s,segs[j+1])
    fwdmap[s]=bits
    print('fwd bits',bits,'state',hex(s))
target=int.from_bytes(bytes(data[291:295]),'big')^0xffffffff
print('target internal final',hex(target))
for bits2 in range(1<<(n-half)):
    s=target
    s=rev(s,segs[n])
    for j in range(n-1,half-1,-1):
        s=rev(s,b'\x0a')
        if bits2>>(j-half)&1: s=rev(s,b'\x0d')
        s=rev(s,segs[j])
    print('bwd bits2',bits2,'req state',hex(s), 'match', s in fwdmap)
# ground truth: full reconstruction both 0d inserted
truth=segs[0]+b'\x0d\x0a'+segs[1]+b'\x0d\x0a'+segs[2]
print('truth crc', hex(zlib.crc32(ctype+truth)&0xffffffff), 'stored', data[291:295].hex())
